def solution():
    # Define variables name and value
    starting_index_value = 121.0
    starting_prices = [15.0, 20.0, 30.0]
    ending_prices = [20.0, 30.0, 25.0]

    # Do math calculation to get the answer
    percentage_changes = [
        (ending_price - starting_price) / starting_price
        for starting_price, ending_price in zip(starting_prices, ending_prices)
    ]
    average_percentage_change = sum(percentage_changes) / len(percentage_changes)
    answer = starting_index_value * (1 + average_percentage_change)

    # return answer
    return round(answer, 3)
